h1: Related products on every product page
overview: We add a related products section to your product pages so shoppers see items that match what they are looking at. We choose rules that suit your catalog, such as same collection, similar price, same tag or what other shoppers viewed, and design the block to match your theme. We test on desktop and phone, check that it does not slow the page and write notes so you can adjust it later.

faq: Do I need an app for this?
Often your theme or a recommendation app can do it. We pick the lightest option that meets your needs. If a paid app is best, we tell you the monthly cost before we install anything.
We keep the block light, load images lazily and test speed before and after. If a tool adds noticeable delay, we tell you and suggest another route.
Can I choose which products appear?
Yes. You can set rules by collection or tag, and Premium adds exclusions, so items such as gift cards or discontinued products never show up as suggestions.
What if my products have little data?
Clean tags and collections make suggestions better. If yours are thin, we add backup rules, and Catalog Data Setup is available as a separate service to improve the source data.
